g.text: Independent center references reduced fixed-location baseline disagreement
Same 90 raw samples before and after correction; no points deleted. No extrapolation; each sample is bracketed by references.
Fixed-XY consistency test only: this does not establish spatial mesh accuracy or separate electrical drift from physical motion.
